# Gameplay Checklist: Flappy Ghost

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the
Flappy Ghost MVP requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality
review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and
satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is
complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the ghost, controls, gravity, pipes, scoring, collisions, ready/game-over states, and restart all covered within the approved MVP? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are edge cases for simultaneous collisions, collision before scoring, pipe repositioning, and score/state reset addressed consistently? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK003 Are gravity and flap behavior defined precisely enough to assess downward acceleration and one upward impulse per separate input without adding unrequested physics rules? [Clarity, Spec §AC-003–AC-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is “visible ghost body” sufficiently defined to make touching or overlapping pipes, ceiling, and floor unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, AC-010–AC-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Is “playable gap” defined with enough criteria to judge whether a repositioned pipe pair remains passable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Do the scoring rules clarify that a reused pipe pair may award one point per successful traversal, rather than only once over the lifetime of the pair? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, AC-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are ready-to-playing and game-over-to-restarted transitions consistent about Space/click input, the restart flap, score reset, and preservation of the final score until restart? [Consistency, Spec §AC-002, AC-013–AC-014, FR-002, FR-010–FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria and Testability

- [ ] CHK008 Is there a Given/When/Then scenario that explicitly states a collision before full clearance ends the run without awarding a point? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, AC-008–AC-012]
- [ ] CHK009 Does each functional requirement map to a relevant Given/When/Then acceptance scenario and, where applicable, a measurable success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-013, AC-001–AC-014, SC-001–SC-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the performance targets objectively assessable across a defined reference desktop/browser setup, beyond the stated viewport dimensions? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001–NFR-003, Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
